Act One
acts.desc:
Magicians say it can take years to create and polish a new magic trick. Teller (of Penn and Teller) shows host Ira Glass how he invented one of his most beautiful and puzzling routines.
See Teller do The Red Ball trick and read a few pages from David P. Abbott’s book, where he describes how to do the floating ball routine.
acts.credits: By Ira Glass, David Kestenbaum, Act Extra, The Floating Ball Routine: An Excerpt from David P. Abbott’s “Book of Mysteries”
acts.title: The Oldest Trick in the Book

acts.desc: Producer David Kestenbaum became obsessed with one trick he loved as a kid—when David Copperfield made the statue of liberty disappear.
